safety_boundary: candidate/projection only; no external code execution, no default permissions, no lifecycle mutation

records.title: Antigravity-style Agent Manager
records.capability_claim: Manage multiple local agents by project/workspace with isolated context, permissions, outputs, and synthesis.

records.title: Artifact + verification bundle
records.capability_claim: Complex tasks should emit reviewable artifacts: plan, diff, tests, screenshots/video, evidence, risks.

records.title: Browser-in-the-loop validation
records.capability_claim: User-facing web/UI work should validate through browser DOM/screenshot/console evidence, not text-only claims.

records.title: Visual artifact feedback loop
records.capability_claim: Screenshots/artifacts should accept targeted user feedback and map it back to task deltas.

records.title: Unified permission model
records.capability_claim: Agent actions should pass a single permission model for files, shell, network, browser, git, cron, and subagents.

records.title: Sandboxed terminal executor
records.capability_claim: Risky shell execution should run in bounded workspace/sandbox mode with file/network damage limits.

records.title: Scheduled agent message workflows
records.capability_claim: Scheduled messages can drive routine agent work if tied to evidence ledgers and human gates.

records.title: Kiro requirements-design-tasks triplet
records.capability_claim: Complex Hermes tasks should materialize requirements.md/design.md/tasks.md equivalents before implementation.

records.title: Bug-analysis spec artifact
records.capability_claim: Costly regressions should start from bug analysis, reproduction, design, and task artifact before code changes.

records.title: Steering hierarchy and inclusion modes
records.capability_claim: Hermes project rules should distinguish global/workspace/task/manual/auto inclusion with workspace overriding global only in scope.

records.title: AGENTS.md compatibility bridge
records.capability_claim: Project AGENTS.md rules should feed Hermes project context as scoped, untrusted workspace guidance, not global memory.

records.title: Agent hooks governance
records.capability_claim: Pre/post tool, file, prompt, and task hooks should support quality/security checks without uncontrolled side effects.

records.title: Hook risk policy matrix
records.capability_claim: Hooks need allow/deny/dry-run policy by event type, command class, workspace, and permission lease.

records.title: OpenSpec proposal/spec delta
records.capability_claim: Hermes should review intent deltas, not only code diffs, for complex capability changes.

records.title: Capability-organized spec store
records.capability_claim: Long-lived specs should live by capability next to code/docs so context survives chat/session boundaries.

records.title: OPSX action workflow
records.capability_claim: Spec work should support propose/apply/update/archive as fluid actions rather than rigid waterfall phases.

records.title: OpenSpec-style project config injection
records.capability_claim: Project context/rules should be injected by artifact type and matching rules instead of global prompt dumping.

records.title: Spec Kit constitution gate
records.capability_claim: Projects should have governing principles that constrain later specs/plans/tasks.

records.title: Executable spec pipeline
records.capability_claim: Specs should become executable implementation inputs with traceable plan/tasks/implementation lineage.

records.title: Mandatory skill routing gate
records.capability_claim: Tasks should load relevant skills before response/execution, but bounded to avoid recursion and system-safety override.

records.title: Brainstorming/design approval gate
records.capability_claim: Creative/feature work should clarify intent and present design before implementation unless low-risk direct action is clearly intended.

records.title: RED-GREEN-REFACTOR enforcement
records.capability_claim: Behavior changes should prefer failing-test-first verification and delete/rework code that bypasses the test gate.

records.title: Systematic root-cause debugging
records.capability_claim: Bug work should prove root cause before fixes; mitigation-only changes must be labeled as such.

records.title: Fresh subagent per task with two-stage review
records.capability_claim: Independent plan tasks can use fresh subagents plus spec-compliance and code-quality review before merge.

records.title: Completion evidence gate
records.capability_claim: No completion claim without fresh verification command/output in the same work slice.

records.title: Human controller invariant
records.capability_claim: Every high-power agent/module should declare its human controller and approval boundary.

records.title: Limited powers invariant
records.capability_claim: Agent powers must be carefully limited through deterministic controls plus dynamic reasoning defenses.

records.title: Plan/action observability invariant
records.capability_claim: Agent planning and actions must be observable through logs, traces, artifacts, and evidence contracts.

records.title: Context engineering layer
records.capability_claim: Context should be assembled from docs, preferences, links, history, and constraints with scoping/compression rules.

records.title: Parallel fan-out/gather pattern
records.capability_claim: Parallel specialist agents should write to unique keys and aggregate through a synthesizer.

records.title: Explain-for-understanding progress UI
records.capability_claim: Hermes progress/explanations should give the user enough decision evidence without dumping internal reasoning.
